title: Iris pseudacorus (Yellow flag, yellow iris)
origin_line: INVASIVE: native to Europe, Western Asia, and Northeast Africa
native_range: Europe, Western Asia, and Northeast Africa
photo_credit: Photo: Myrabella / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?curid=19482170
impact: Outcompetes native species by forming dense, impenetrable colonies. Because they grow in wet environments, the seeds are able to spread via water. This plant is toxic to animals.
